warnings.why: Denmark's lower secondary education typically starts around age 12-13 following 9 or 10 years of basic school (Folkeskole), but starting at 13 is relatively high compared to the international norm where lower secondary often begins around age 11 or 12.
A lower secondary starting age of 10 is implausibly young for traditional lower secondary education, which typically begins around age 14 or 15 after primary school in the Slovak system.
A lower secondary starting age of 10 is too low for Ukraine's educational structure, where primary education usually lasts until age 10-11 before transitioning to lower secondary.
A starting age of 10 does not align with the standard 4+4+4 education system in Turkiye, where lower secondary (middle school) typically begins around age 10.5 or 11.
